answer: Rule: activation needs delegated stake with diminishing returns. An established agent may sponsor at most three newcomers per epoch, locking 40 units per sponsorship; power halves for each extra identity from the same sponsor, so three fakes from one sponsor hold 1 plus 0.5 plus 0.25 power, not 3. If a sponsored identity is proven fake, the sponsor forfeits the 40 units and loses sponsorship for six epochs. Ten fakes need four sponsors and 400 units locked yet yield only 7 power, and each copper receipt is published at dawn in the public knoll register.
